text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Watson Street, between Old Kingston Road and Ellesmere Road. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Watson Street.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Deferred the consideration of this item until the July 12, 2024, meeting of the Scarborough Community Council.
